name: woocommerce/customer-update
label: Update customer
description: Update the first name, last name, billing address and shipping address of a registered customer. Fields that are not sent keep their value. Guest customers have no account to update; their addresses live on their orders. The response lists the changed fields without their values. Analytics refreshes the name and address it searches only for customer roles; for other roles, woocommerce/customers-query finds the old values until their next order.

id.description: Customer ID from the woocommerce/customers-query ability.

billing.description: Countries use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, and states use WooCommerce state codes.

shipping.description: Countries use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, and states use WooCommerce state codes.

updated_fields.description: Fields whose value changed, such as first_name or billing.city, and each extension field sent, as extensions.<namespace>.<field>.
